# Locally hosted dependencies

These browser ES modules are unmodified files from the corresponding version-pinned npm packages. They require no package installation on the production server and make no CDN requests.

- **Three.js 0.180.0**: `three/three.module.js`, `three/three.core.js`, and `three/LICENSE`. Package source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz. MIT license.
- **GSAP 3.13.0**: `gsap/index.js`, `gsap/gsap-core.js`, `gsap/CSSPlugin.js`, `gsap/ScrollTrigger.js`, and `gsap/Observer.js`. Package source: https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-3.13.0.tgz. The npm package identifies its license as "Standard 'no charge' license: https://gsap.com/standard-license." Each source file retains its original license header.

Official documentation: https://threejs.org/docs/ and https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Plugins/ScrollTrigger/.
